selection_reasoning: These 8 tasks form a coherent multi-hop benchmark with three parallel branches: (1) A navigation-to-barrier branch (find yellow_banner → find light_blue_terracotta → mine black_terracotta → sell Stone) where the banner is a waypoint leading to the terracotta wall, and the black terracotta physically blocks access to the villager; (2) A wayfinding branch (find spruce_wood → mine jungle_sign → sell Stone) where the sign on the spruce pillar provides directional text to the merchant; (3) An independent climbing branch (find quartz_stairs → mine potted_pink_tulip) testing vertical navigation. The tasks test navigation, landmark identification, block mining with correct tools, and NPC trading interaction. All dependencies are physically or logically enforced by the scene design.

edges.reason: The yellow_banner marks the entrance to the terracotta display; approaching it reveals the light_blue_terracotta wall behind it
Black_terracotta is embedded within the light_blue_terracotta wall; finding the wall locates the correct block to mine
The potted_pink_tulip sits atop the quartz platform; the stairs are the only climbable path to reach it at y+3
The jungle_wall_sign is physically mounted on the spruce_wood pillar; locating the wood locates the sign
The black_terracotta forms a wall blocking the only corridor to the villager trading post; mining it opens the path
The jungle_sign displays 'Stone Merchant → Northeast' text; reading and mining it provides directional guidance to the villager

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The yellow banner is at spawn-relative (6, 1, -5), ~7.8 blocks from spawn. max_distance=4 forces the player to actually navigate northeast toward the banner rather than satisfying the milestone from spawn. facing_tolerance=45° ensures the player is oriented toward the banner, modeling 'player can see it'.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The light_blue_terracotta wall center is at spawn-relative (10, 1, -8), ~12.8 blocks from spawn and ~5 blocks further NE from the yellow banner. max_distance=4 requires the player to walk past the banner and approach the terracotta wall closely. The 5-block separation between this target and the banner target ensures they cannot trigger simultaneously with max_distance=4.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The quartz stairs are at spawn-relative (-8, 0, -2), ~8.2 blocks west of spawn. max_distance=5 requires the player to navigate west. This target is well-separated (13+ blocks) from the spruce wood target to the south, preventing simultaneous triggering.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The spruce wood pillar center is at spawn-relative (-4, 1, 10), ~10.8 blocks south of spawn. max_distance=5 requires the player to navigate south toward the pillar. The jungle_wall_sign is mounted on this pillar, so finding the wood also locates the sign for the subsequent mine task.

Uses inventory_has because mining black_terracotta with the provided wooden_pickaxe causes it to drop as an item into the player's inventory. Terracotta requires a pickaxe to drop — without one it breaks but yields nothing. The barrier is 6 blocks (2x3) but mining just 1 confirms the player has begun clearing the path to the villager room. The physical barrier itself enforces that the player must mine at least 2 blocks (bottom row) to walk through.

Uses inventory_has because mining a jungle_wall_sign drops a 'jungle_sign' item into the player's inventory. Wall signs and standing signs share the same item ID when dropped. The sign can be broken instantly by hand or faster with the provided wooden_axe. The sign is at spawn-relative (-4, 1, 9) mounted on the spruce_wood pillar.

Uses inventory_has because breaking a potted_pink_tulip drops both a flower_pot and a pink_tulip as separate items into the player's inventory. Potted plants break instantly with any tool or bare hand. The tulip is at spawn-relative (-8, 3, -5) atop the quartz platform, requiring the player to first climb the quartz stairs. Checking for pink_tulip is sufficient proof the pot was broken.

Uses inventory_has to check for emerald because the mason villager's trade exchanges 20 stone for 1 emerald. The player starts with 64 stone and 0 emeralds (no emeralds in starting inventory or scene). Any emerald in inventory must come from completing a trade with the villager. The player must first mine through the black terracotta barrier to physically reach the villager inside the enclosed room, then interact with the trading GUI to execute the sale.

scene_description: A compact multi-area scene within 15 blocks of spawn featuring four distinct zones connected by open pathways: (1) A yellow banner waypoint leading to a light_blue_terracotta display wall in the northeast, (2) An enclosed stone brick villager room behind the terracotta wall, accessible only through a doorway blocked by black_terracotta, (3) A quartz staircase in the west leading to an elevated platform with a potted pink tulip, and (4) A spruce wood pillar in the south with a directional jungle wall sign. The villager room physical enclosure enforces the mine→sell dependency, requiring the player to mine through the terracotta barrier to reach the mason villager.
task_text: Explore this area to find landmarks (yellow banner, light blue terracotta, quartz stairs, spruce wood), mine key blocks (black terracotta barrier, jungle sign, potted pink tulip), and sell Stone to the merchant villager behind the terracotta wall.
design_notes: Target Minecraft version: 1.20.4. Layout: NE has yellow banner waypoint at (6,1,-5) leading to light_blue_terracotta wall at (9-11,0-2,-8). Behind the terracotta wall is an enclosed stone brick room (walls at z=-10, z=-14, x=8, x=14) with the only entrance being a 2-wide doorway at (10-11,0-2,-10) blocked by 6 black_terracotta blocks. Mason villager (NoAI) inside at (11,1,-12). West has quartz staircase at (-8,0,-2) ascending north to platform at y=2 with potted_pink_tulip at (-8,3,-5). South has spruce wood pillar at (-4,0-2,10) with jungle_wall_sign at (-4,1,9) facing south displaying 'Stone Merchant → Northeast'. Player given 64 stone, wooden_pickaxe (for terracotta), and wooden_axe (for sign). All areas require 4-12 blocks of navigation from spawn.
